format: single Pet Supplies Plus retail store (leased, approximately 5,000 to 8,000 sq ft)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operation of a Pet Supplies Plus® franchise is $520,250 to $1,818,900. This includes $244,900 to $354,900 that must be paid to the franchisor or an affiliate.

fee.quote: You must pay PSP a lump sum initial franchise fee of $49,900 when you sign the Franchise Agreement (the "Initial Franchise Fee").
fee.note: Waived for approved conversions of an existing retail pet store; $35,000 for an existing franchisee's second and later Stores; VetFran 20% off; First Responder 10% off; PSP employees $10,000. Also paid to PSP before opening: $15,000 Set Up Fee and $30,000 Grand Opening advertising. Multi-Unit Fee: $49,900 for the first Store plus $35,000 per additional Store.

royalty.basis: monthly Gross Sales (2% for the first 12 months of operation, 3% thereafter)
royalty.quote: Royalty 2% of monthly Gross Sales for first 12 months of operation; 3% of monthly Gross sales after first 12 months of operation

adFund.quote: For all subsequent months after the first 12 months of operation, the required monthly advertising contribution shall be the lesser of 3.5% of Gross Sales or $8,333.00 ("the Advertising Contribution Monthly Cap") with (a) 2/3 of that amount directed to the LMS ... and (b) 1/3 of that amount to the NAF.
adFund.note: 3.5% is the total advertising requirement (2/3 Local Marketing Spend, 1/3 National Advertising Fund), capped at $8,333.00 per month and $100,000 per year. First 12 months: fixed $3,350 per month LMS plus $1,000 to the NAF. Grand Opening $30,000 before opening.

otherRecurring.name: Technology Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $1,500 per month based on Store build out and services you select (may increase up to 10% annually)

otherRecurring.name: Point of Sale (POS) Leasing Payments
otherRecurring.amount: Estimated at $295-$431 per month plus tax

otherRecurring.name: Grooming Scheduling Software
otherRecurring.amount: Currently, $1,620 per year charged at $135 per month, plus text-message fees (stores offering grooming)

otherRecurring.name: Local Marketing Spend + NAF, first 12 months
otherRecurring.amount: $3,350 per month in Local Marketing Spend and $1,000 to the National Advertising Fund

otherRecurring.name: 3rd Party Courier Deliver from Store Fees (optional)
otherRecurring.amount: typically ranges from $150 to $1,700 per month

otherRecurring.name: Annual Conference Fee
otherRecurring.amount: Up to $2,000 per person (up to two attendees per entity)

special: Approximately 75% to 90% of initial inventory ($112,500 to $234,000 of $150,000 to $260,000) must be bought from affiliate PSP Distribution, which also supplies ongoing inventory (payments collected by EFT); POS equipment must be leased from the franchisor. Low royalty (2% then 3%) but retail model with ~62% cost of goods (37.8% average gross margin).
issues: Item 7 excludes purchase of real estate (assumes a leased store; includes leasehold improvements and prepaid rent/deposit). Item 6 does not say whether the first-year $1,000 NAF contribution is monthly. Item 19 gives gross margin, rent and labor but no profit figure, so profitPct is null.
